cards.t: Binance Suffers Record $6.3B Hack and Subsequent Outflows
cards.b: Binance experienced a record $6.3 billion hack, prompting heavy withdrawals totaling $3.64 billion after services resumed alongside reserve proof updates.

per.BNB: Binance Coin processed massive outflows and withdrawals following the security breach.
per.BTC: Bitcoin faced heavy outflows and pressure as Binance withdrawals reopened.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total final recovery amount and identity of all affected user funds.

cards.t: Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals Following $40M-$46M Security Breach
cards.b: Brazil's largest crypto exchange, Mercado Bitcoin, halted deposits and withdrawals after a security breach drained approximately $40 to $46 million across multiple chains.

per.USDT: Tether froze over 4.5 million USDT connected to the Mercado Bitcoin breach.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact final loss figures and timeline for full platform restoration.

cards.t: Strategy Buys More Bitcoin and Executes STRC Buybacks
cards.b: Strategy allocated capital to buy back $208.2 million of its STRC preferred shares and acquired additional Bitcoin holdings.

per.BTC: Strategy expanded its corporate Bitcoin treasury holdings through further market purchases.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Remaining cash reserves allocated for future purchases.

cards.t: XRP Ledger Prepares Fix for Stablecoin Token Minting Flaw
cards.b: The XRP Ledger is on track to implement a software fix addressing a flaw concerning stablecoin partners minting new tokens.

per.XRP: XRP token itself remains unaffected by the underlying vulnerability being patched.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact activation time for the network patch.
